ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude,glob)**/*.md'; then echo 'Only docs changed since the last deployment: skipping the build'; exit 0; else exit 1; fi
